dialogues.speaker: Fassben
dialogues.text: The photo-taking is in your capable hands, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Fassben
dialogues.text: If we can call this a job well done, Cyrus should be more inclined to approve our request to set up a Kamera Club.

dialogues.speaker: Fassben
dialogues.text: And as long as we can set it up, we should be able to attract more Kamera enthusiasts and further refine the art of taking pictures!

dialogues.speaker: Fassben
dialogues.text: Perhaps we might even be able to invite hobbyists from other nations...

dialogues.speaker: Fassben
dialogues.text: W—Well, would you look at that? I'm getting rather ahead of myself, aren't I? Focus, man, focus — focus on the work at hand.
